label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, footer headers, badges (Inter, uppercase, tracked).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Reserved for true floating overlays: the navigation mega-menu, cart drawer, modals. Never used on resting cards or buttons.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover transforms and image scale (nav underline, product image zoom).

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on buttons, links, inputs.

motion.name: duration-media
motion.purpose: Image scale/opacity transitions on product cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default solid CTA — Forest Ledger fill, Sage Mist label, square corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-bg-espresso, #1B3D2A); color: var(--color-bg-cream, #EBF3EC); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--color-accent-warm, #3A7D44); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-warm, #3A7D44); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA — transparent with a 1px Forest Ledger border, fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-bg-espresso, #1B3D2A); border: 1px solid var(--color-bg-espresso, #1B3D2A); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background: var(--color-bg-espresso, #1B3D2A); color: var(--color-bg-cream, #EBF3EC); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-warm, #3A7D44); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Airy outline CTA for hero/footer contexts over photography or dark backgrounds; wider padding than the other two.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); border: 1px solid var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 48px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); color: var(--color-bg-cream, #EBF3EC); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-warm, #3A7D44); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Badge
components.description: Small pill badge for product tags/status — the narrow exception to the system's square-corner default.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-text-light, #7A9B82); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Retail collection card — square image container with hover zoom, centered Inter name/price beneath.
components.html:
Kathmandu Field Shirt

From £75
components.css: .ds-product-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-product-card__image { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-rule-light, #D6E6D8); aspect-ratio: 3/4; } .ds-product-card__image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-card__image img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-product-card__info { margin-top: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-product-card__name { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-product-card__price { margin-top: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4D6B55); }

components.name: Boxed Input
components.description: Multi-field form input (e.g. /quote) — full 1px border box, focus swaps border to Highland Moss.
components.css: .ds-field__label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4D6B55); } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #C2D6C6); background: var(--color-bg-white, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent-warm, #3A7D44); }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Single-field low-commitment input (newsletter signup) — border-bottom only, no box.
components.css: .ds-underline-field { display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #C2D6C6); transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-underline-field:focus-within { border-bottom-color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); } .ds-underline-field__input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 8px 0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); } .ds-underline-field__input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-underline-field__submit { background: none; border: none; padding: 4px; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1A1A1A); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-underline-field__submit:hover { color: var(--color-text-muted, #4D6B55); }

components.name: Stat Card (Corner Accent)
components.description: Signature dark-section stat card with a corner-accent bracket motif — used only inside the Forest Ledger 'Verified Impact' section.
components.html:
2.5x

Living Wage Index

Paid well above the average living wage in our partner studio.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-stat-card::before, .ds-stat-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-stat-card::before { top: 0; left: 0; border-top: 1px solid; border-left: 1px solid; } .ds-stat-card::after { bottom: 0; right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid; border-right: 1px solid; } .ds-stat-card__value { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-stat-card__value small { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 300; color: #8FA89B; margin-left: 2px; } .ds-stat-card__label { margin-top: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8FA89B; } .ds-stat-card__desc { margin-top: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(235,243,236,0.75); }

narrative.overview: Kazi Manufacturing's site reads like a working ledger kept by a precise Kathmandu workshop — every fabric, tailor, certification, and claim entered as a line item, not narrated as a mood. Forest Ledger (the deep green, #1B3D2A) behaves as the ledger's ink: it anchors headings, primary actions, and the one full-bleed dark section on every page, never as decoration. Hairline rule lines stand in for the ruled lines of a physical ledger page; alphanumeric codes (SVC-01, FAB-01, GAR-001) are literal entry numbers, not stylistic flourish. The voice is precise and grounded: closer to a technical spec sheet than a mood board, confident without resorting to soft-focus lifestyle-brand language, and willing to state a shortfall as plainly as a win. Imagery and copy return again and again to the same well — Kathmandu's textile heritage, named artisans, terraced highland farms, the Himalayas as literal backdrop — because specificity is the credibility mechanism, not scale or spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Spec-sheet structure: alphanumeric codes, bordered rows, exact figures over adjectives.
Forest green as structural ink, not accent — the one dark, full-bleed "Verified Impact" section is the ledger's stamped seal.
Two distinct corner languages: square (0px) for structural buttons and panels; full pill (999px) reserved narrowly for tags, counters, and swatches.
Uppercase, wide-tracked micro-labels (Inter, 0.12–0.35em) sit above nearly every heading, display, and section eyebrow.
Newsreader serif italics/roman for storytelling passages only — never for UI chrome.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Forest Ledger is a structural color, not a decorative one: it appears on primary CTAs, headings, and exactly one dark section type per page. It never appears as a background tint or a random accent fill.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation between content blocks is drawn with a 1px rule/rule-light border, not a box-shadow. The single exception is the navigation mega-menu overlay (0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.07)), which is a true floating overlay, not a resting surface.

rules.name: The One-Serif-Per-Job Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is structural (headings, eyebrows); Newsreader is narrative (long-form passages); Inter is functional (everything else). No page mixes Cinzel and Newsreader for the same job.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, and panels carry zero shadow at rest. If a component needs to read as "above" the page rather than "on" it — dropdowns, modals, the cart drawer — that is the only case for introducing a shadow, and it should match the Overlay value rather than inventing a new one.

dos: Do keep Forest Ledger structural — headings, primary fills, and the one dark section per page — never a background tint or random accent.
Do use hairline borders (rule / rule-light, 1px) as the default separator; reach for the Overlay shadow only for true floating elements (mega-menu, cart drawer, modals).
Do pair every display/headline with an uppercase, wide-tracked Inter eyebrow or label above it.
Do keep square (0px) corners on anything structural; reserve pill (999px) corners for tags, badges, counters, and swatches only.
Do keep Newsreader exclusive to narrative passages — never nav, buttons, or labels.
donts: Don't rename espresso/cream tokens to literal brown/beige — the values are correct forest-green/sage, only the names are legacy.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons at rest; depth comes from flat color blocks and hairlines.
Don't build new dark surfaces on the leftover .tech-card / .corner-accent / #E5232A red-accent utility block in globals.css — it's unused debris from an earlier design pass, not a second valid theme.
Don't mix Cinzel and Newsreader in the same component — Cinzel is structural, Newsreader is narrative.
